# V5 aggregate (auto-generated by aggregate_v5.py; conclusions are in CONCLUSIONS_V5.md)

Runs included: 27 (discovered under `runs/*_v5/*` with `summary.csv`). Analysis source: `results_v5/full/` (analyze_v5.py, level 0.9, cluster bootstrap, uncorrected for multiple comparisons). Independent unit = (model, seed, concept, region); fixed methods are alpha-independent and counted once per unit; different alphas are within-unit sensitivity. Convention: diff = metric(a) − metric(b); every metric here is lower-is-better, so diff > 0 means b (the adaptive `dua` method) is better; `(ns)` marks intervals crossing 0. `kl_park` is NOT a true KL (Park's 5e-3 offset; can be negative); it is only a reproduction of Park's metric. `cf` has no direction and is never used for better/worse claims.

## 5. 优势回归（Q-C）与预测变量相关

来源：`results_v5/full/advantage_regression.csv`、`results_v5/full/predictor_corr.csv`。回归为逐上下文 OLS（按 run 去均值的固定效应 + 按簇自助法 95% 区间）；`coef_per_SD` = 预测变量标准化后的系数。本节展示 C1/C2 两个配对在 `kl` 与 `kl_park` 上的 joint 与单变量模型；其余 metric/配对见 CSV 全表（不删减，仅不在本文重复）。**相关分析，不作因果表述。**

来源：`results_v5/full/null_control_summary.csv`（全表）。null = 结构化零探针（标签打乱/随机词对）经**同一种度量**、走与真实路径**相同步数**的终点；每个 run 抽 `--null_ctx 30` 个零探针上下文、每上下文 `--null_draws 3` 次 draw 取均值后，仅保留与真实路径（level 0.9 `reached=1`）可配对的上下文，故 `n` 可小于 30。`real − null` 为簇自助法 95% 区间。`null/real` 比为本表由 real/null 列计算（real ≤ 0 或非有限时记 `n/a`）。任务书 §8.3 的判读（`dua_*` 的 `kl` null/real ≥ 0.5）属结论层，见 CONCLUSIONS_V5.md。
